items.title: Peter Vacher interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001
items.q: in the background of the tapes you can hear her saying, “He doesn’t want to know about that, Joe.”

ctx.x: What was the reason for that?

Well Joe was quite a colorful character, and if you read this book you’ll say the ways in which he was colorful. Joe was a Creole from Louisiana who was first married to a Creole woman, well basically because he put her in the family way, secondly he was married to a black lady, and thirdly he was married to a white woman. So as he always said to me, he covered all bases as you would put it. And the third Mrs. Darensbourg, who is a very nice lady, but I think she was from North Carolina, quite straight laced. And…
What does his wife think of the book?
